svg.desc: 800 × 480 RGB565 • wuxx PMOD-RGBLCD v1.3 • Proposed wiring; match your hardware revision before powering it.
svg.text: BRS-100 · RGB LCD + TM1638 jumper connections
800 × 480 RGB565 • wuxx PMOD-RGBLCD v1.3 • Proposed wiring; match your hardware revision before powering it.
LCD signal jumpers · one line = one wire
Rows below are grouped by signal, not physical socket order.
RGB bits 0 → 4/5 run from least to most significant.
BRS-100 · component side · USB-C at top
J6.1 = GPIO 17. J6.17 is GND, not GPIO 17.
Adapter J2 · v1.3 PCB component-side view
Follow the PCB pin-1 mark; do not count odd/even.
* J2.8 via R3; J2.23 via R4. Both are 0 Ω links.
TM1638 · use a 3.3 V ↔ 5 V translator
Example: TXS0104E module; A = 3.3 V, B = 5 V.
DIO is bidirectional. Do not connect a 5 V module directly to GPIO.
J5.18 (+5 V) → adapter J2.23, TM1638 VCC, translator VCCB. Leave the adapter USB-C unplugged.
J6.18 (+3.3 V) → adapter J2.6, translator VCCA and OE. Use a power distribution strip for fan-out.
J5.17 / J6.17 (GND) → adapter J2.5 + J2.14 + J2.17 + J2.26, translator GND and TM1638 GND.
Open adapter SB1–SB4 for independent RGB565. Seat the compatible 40-pin panel in J1 with power removed.
Keep signal jumpers short. Optional microphone / DAC / three spare GPIOs: see wiring_audio.svg and README.md.
Configuration: brisbane_brs_100_tm1638_pmod_rgblcd_800_480_by_codex · Signal source: wiring.csv · References and limitations: README.md
